annotations.title: Explain what a user or roles may do on a board

description: Say what a user, or a list of roles, may do on a board under its policy: which rows they read and write, which columns, create and delete. Pass boardId and exactly one of userId (an app user from list_app_users; the answer includes the roles that person has) or roles (role keys, to try a role before anyone holds it). Changes nothing; use it after every set_board_policy. Requires organization owner or admin.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

roles.description: Role keys to explain, e.g. ["agent"]. Pass this or userId

userId.description: An app user's id (from list_app_users). Pass this or roles

name: explain_access
